type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: li zeta ledger: record run 40149747655 [skip ci]
li zeta: frontier ledger V3 and single axiom-summary annotation
li zeta: lowest off-line zero, finite threshold, two-worlds theorem, Hardy Z link
li criterion: port to Mathlib v4.35.0 and apply to riemannZeta
experiment: Li's criterion, finite core (both directions)

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.exists_lowest_offline_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ¬LiCriterion.Zeta.StripRH →   ∃ ρ,     LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero ρ ∧       ρ.re ≠ 1 / 2 ∧ ∀ (s : ℂ), LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero s → |s.im| < |ρ.im| → s.re = 1 / 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.hardyZ_im_eq_zero
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero s → s.re = 1 / 2 → hardyZ s.im = 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc_criterion
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re) ↔ ∀ s ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T, s.re = 1 / 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc_eq_liCoeff
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ), LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n = LiCriterion.liCoeff (fun ρ => ↑ρ) n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc_eq_li_original
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ∑ ρ ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosFinset T, (1 - (1 - 1 / ρ) ^ n) = LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc_threshold_of_not_RH
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ¬RiemannHypothesis →   ∃ T₀,     0 ≤ T₀ ∧ (∀ T < T₀, ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re) ∧ ∃ n, (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T₀ n).re < 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.li_two_worlds
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (∀ (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re) ∨   ∃ T₀,     0 ≤ T₀ ∧ (∀ T < T₀, ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T n).re) ∧ ∃ n, (LiCriterion.Zeta.liTrunc T₀ n).re < 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.mem_zerosFinset
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {T : ℝ} {s : ℂ}, s ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosFinset T ↔ s ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.one_sub_mem_zerosUpTo
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {T : ℝ} {s : ℂ}, s ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T → 1 - s ∈ LiCriterion.Zeta.zerosUpTo T

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.stripZero_of_hardyZ
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {t : ℝ}, hardyZ t = 0 → LiCriterion.Zeta.StripZero (1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I) ∧ (1 / 2 + ↑t * Complex.I).re = 1 / 2

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.Zeta.trivial_of_re_nonpos
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {s : ℂ}, riemannZeta s = 0 → s.re ≤ 0 → ∃ n, s = -2 * (↑n + 1)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.exists_liCoeff_re_neg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → (∃ i, 1 / 2 < (ρ i).re) → ∃ n, (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re < 0

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_eq_li_original
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) →     ∀ (σ : ι ≃ ι), (∀ (i : ι), ρ (σ i) = 1 - ρ i) → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i, (1 - (1 - 1 / ρ i) ^ n) = LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_re
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (ρ : ι → ℂ) (n : ℕ),   (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re = ↑(Fintype.card ι) - ∑ i, (LiCriterion.liPoint (ρ i) ^ n).re

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.liCoeff_re_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → (∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re ≤ 1 / 2) → ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.li_criterion_finite
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) → ((∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re ≤ 1 / 2)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LiCriterion.li_criterion_finite_symm
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {ρ : ι → ℂ},   (∀ (i : ι), ρ i ≠ 1) →     ∀ (σ : ι → ι),       (∀ (i : ι), ρ (σ i) = 1 - ρ i) → ((∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ (LiCriterion.liCoeff ρ n).re) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), (ρ i).re = 1 / 2)
